entities.summary: Palazzetto da Lezze is a small Gothic palace located in Venice, Italy, in the Cannaregio district and overlooking the Grand Canal at the mouth of the Rio di Noale. The palazzetto is situated between the Palazzo Boldù a San Felice and the Casa Gussoni Grimani della Vida, opposite the Ca' Pesaro.
